Build an explicit OneDev connection

Source: R/connection.R
od_connection.Rd

Prefer this over environment variables for scripts and multi-host workflows. Pass the result as conn = to high-level helpers, or register it as the package default with od_set_connection().

Usage

od_connection(
  host,
  token,
  project_path = NULL,
  project_id = NULL,
  repo_url = NULL,
  default_issue_state = NULL,
  insecure_ssl = FALSE,
  validate = TRUE
)

Arguments

host

OneDev base URL (e.g. "https://git.example.test").

token

API access token (Bearer).

project_path

Project path (e.g. "group/my-project").

project_id

Optional numeric project id (skips path resolution when set).

repo_url

Optional git remote URL; used to derive project_path when that is unset.

default_issue_state

Optional default for od_query_issues() when no query/state is given.

insecure_ssl

If TRUE, skip TLS certificate verification.

validate

If TRUE (default), error when host or token are empty.

Value

A named list with the same fields as od_get_config(), classed as od_connection.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
conn <- od_connection(
  host = "https://git.example.test",
  token = Sys.getenv("ONEDEV_API_TOKEN"),
  project_path = "group/my-project"
)
od_get_issue(145, conn = conn)
} # }
